# TextAlign

`Flare.Components.TextAlign`

Horizontal text alignment for FlareText. Default inherits the surrounding alignment; the other values map to text-align via shared flare-text--align-* classes (no inline style needed).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Default` | `0` | Inherit the surrounding text alignment (no override). |
| `Start` | `1` | Align to the start (writing-direction aware). |
| `Left` | `2` | Align to the left. |
| `Center` | `3` | Center. |
| `Right` | `4` | Align to the right. |
| `End` | `5` | Align to the end (writing-direction aware). |
| `Justify` | `6` | Justify (stretch lines to both edges). |

## Used by components

- `FlareText`
